key_people.title: 院长（Ректор）
key_people.title_description: Rector (chief executive) of the academy, professor of oncology; appointed by order of the Minister of Education and Science
key_people.description: Professor of oncology; confirmed as Rector of KSMA. Previously Vice-Rector for Research (2000-2004), Director of the Kyrgyz Research Institute of Oncology and Radiology (1997-2000). Awarded the 'Excellence in Education' badge in 2024 on the academy's 85th anniversary.

departments.name: General Medicine Faculty (Лечебный факультет)
departments.description: Founded 1939. The largest faculty; trains physicians in General Medicine. ~1500 students. 6-year program taught in Russian and Kyrgyz.

departments.name: Pediatrics Faculty (Педиатрический факультет)
departments.description: Founded 1956. Trains pediatricians. 6-year program in Russian and Kyrgyz.

departments.name: Dentistry Faculty (Стоматологический факультет)
departments.description: Founded 1960. Trains dentists (врач-стоматолог). 5-year program in Russian and Kyrgyz.

departments.name: Pharmacy Faculty (Факультет фармации)
departments.description: Founded 1981. Trains pharmacists (провизор). 5-year program in Russian, with evening division for second higher education.

departments.name: Public Health Faculty (Факультет общественного здравоохранения)
departments.description: Founded 1998. Trains healthcare managers and public health specialists (медико-профилактическое дело). 5-year program in Russian.

departments.name: Higher Nursing Education Faculty (Факультет высшего сестринского образования)
departments.description: Founded 1998. Trains nursing managers and instructors. 5-year (secondary base) or 4-year (specialized secondary base) program.

departments.name: Faculty for Foreign Citizens (Факультет для иностранных граждан)
departments.description: Founded on the basis of the English-language division of the General Medicine Faculty (2001). 6-year English-medium program. Hosts large numbers of students from India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, UAE, Nepal and other countries.

departments.name: Postgraduate Medical Education Faculty (Факультет последипломного медицинского образования)
departments.description: Provides residency and specialization training in Russian and (for select specialties) English.

departments.name: Military Medical Training Department (Кафедра военно-медицинской подготовки)
departments.description: Created October 1941 during WWII; provides military medical training for students of medical, pediatric, dental, sanitary and pharmaceutical departments. Part of the Armed Forces of the Kyrgyz Republic training system.

departments.name: Central Research Laboratory (Центральная научно-исследовательская лаборатория)
departments.description: Core scientific research unit coordinating biomedical and clinical investigations.

departments.name: International Cooperation Office (Управление международных связей)
departments.description: Coordinates partnerships with 100+ foreign universities and international organizations (WHO, DAAD, Erasmus+, JICA, Soros-Kyrgyzstan, etc.).

recent_events.title: 528 foreign students graduated from the English-medium General Medicine Faculty
recent_events.description: On June 3-4, 2026, KSMA held a solemn graduation ceremony for 528 international students of the English-medium Faculty of General Medicine No. 1, reflecting the academy's large and growing international student body.

recent_events.title: Rector Kudaybergenova announces educational franchise reform for medical schools
recent_events.description: At a press conference in the Ministry of Health, Rector Indira Kudaybergenova explained mechanisms for implementing educational franchises and mandatory state accreditation for all medical schools. Private institutions must partner with accredited universities like KSMA to maintain quality standards. A new Center for International Education will promote Kyrgyzstan as a medical education destination.

recent_events.title: Japanese delegation visit: outcomes and future cooperation
recent_events.description: Rector Indira Kudaybergenova took part in a concluding meeting with a Japanese delegation at KSMA on March 26, 2026, summarizing results of the official visit and discussing further directions of cooperation, including experience exchange, training, and modern methods of treatment and patient care.

recent_events.title: Archa POU innovative water purification technology launched at KSMA
recent_events.description: On March 27, 2026, KSMA launched the Archa POU innovative water purification installation, supported by Japanese partners, improving campus health infrastructure.

recent_events.title: State monopoly on medical education signed into law
recent_events.description: In August 2025, President Sadyr Japarov signed a decree introducing a state monopoly on training medical personnel, triggering major reforms in which KSMA, as the flagship state academy, plays a central role in franchising curriculum and absorbing students from non-accredited private medical schools.

recent_events.title: Rector Kudaybergenova awarded 'Excellence in Education' badge on 85th anniversary
recent_events.description: Professor Indira Kudaybergenova was awarded the 'Отличник образования' (Excellence in Education) badge in honor of KSMA's 85th anniversary.

core_business: 吉尔吉斯国立医学院（KSMA，原名 KGMA）是吉尔吉斯斯坦历史最悠久的医学高等院校，成立于 1939 年 9 月 1 日。学院以首任院长、首任吉尔吉斯外科医生伊萨·科诺耶维奇·阿洪巴耶夫（I.K. Akhunbaev）命名，隶属于吉尔吉斯斯坦卫生部。设有内科、儿科、口腔、药学、公共卫生、高等护理教育、外国留学生（英语授课）和毕业后医学教育等院系，提供本科、硕士、住院医师及博士研究生培养。学院拥有中央科研实验室、学生科学学会、基础医学与生物学研究所等研究机构，是吉尔吉斯斯坦医学教育与科研的旗舰机构。建校以来培养了超过 30,000 名医生，现有来自印度、巴基斯坦、孟加拉国、阿联酋、尼泊尔等大量外国留学生。
apec_stance: 吉尔吉斯斯坦非 APEC 成员国，KSMA 与 APEC 成员经济体（中国、日本、韩国、俄罗斯、美国）保持广泛学术合作。学院与延世大学原州校区（韩国，2009）、河北医科大学（中国）、牡丹江医学院（中国，2001）、新西伯利亚国立医学院（俄罗斯，2003）等 APEC 国家院校签有合作协议。日本 JICA 长期派遣志愿者并资助基础设施（如 2026 年 3 月落成的 Archa POU 水净化装置）。作为 WHO、DAAD、Erasmus+ 等国际组织的合作伙伴，KSMA 大量招收印度、巴基斯坦等南亚留学生，2026 年 6 月英语授课院系毕业 528 名留学生。学院 2026 年主导吉尔吉斯斯坦医学教育'特许经营'改革，作为国家旗舰机构对私立医学院进行质量监管。
